title: I vibe-coded a parkour FPS for fun... and it turned into a hub of 30 AI-made browser games
author: LTD1827
selftext:
https://preview.redd.it/bn8oxpkcxeth1.png?width=1001&format=png&auto=webp&s=837d12b50149147d0708ba556dc5571170b4cb8c

Hey everyone,

A while ago I saw someone vibe-code a CS-style shooter in about 3 hours, so I tried it myself and built a parkour FPS. Then I kept going, and it grew into VIBE GAMING: a hub for vibe-coded browser games, mine and the community's.

Why: I hadn't played games in a long time. Every time I wanted to, it meant big downloads, and I switch between several machines. So I wanted games that open instantly in a browser tab on any device.

How: every game is plain HTML + JavaScript, no game engine, written with AI (mostly Claude) while I steer, test and review. The hub itself was built the same way.

Where it's at now:

* 30 games: parkour FPS, ragdoll brawler, Backrooms horror, co-op party games, racing, a block-building sandbox, chill mini games and more
* Online multiplayer: peer-to-peer rooms, voice chat, spectating, and rooms that survive the host leaving
* Any device: phone, tablet, PC, with touch controls that hide when you use a keyboard or gamepad
* English / Vietnamese / Chinese, light and dark themes
* Free, no install, no download

You can also submit your own AI-made game. Every submission is reviewed by hand before it goes live, to keep the quality up.

👉[https://vibegaming.top](https://vibegaming.top/)

I'd love feedback: what's fun, what's broken, what you'd want next.
